checksum_valid.fail: Line {line}: the record's checksum block says {declared}, which does not match the record's characters
checksum_valid.suggestion: Re-export the file from the CAD system; a checksum mismatch means the line was altered or truncated in transit

header_field_order.fail: Line {line}: header block is not conform - {problem}
header_field_order.suggestion: Write every header field the super-group requires, in the order the standard fixes, with the identifier present even when the value is empty
header_field_order.missing_block: the record carries no header block
header_field_order.order: fields are not in the order the standard fixes

geometry_excludes_spacer.fail: Line {line}: the record carries a geometry block and a spacer block, which cannot both appear on one line
geometry_excludes_spacer.suggestion: Split the shape into one record carrying the geometry and one carrying the spacer positions

ascii_only.fail: Line {line}: the record holds characters outside ASCII ({characters})
ascii_only.suggestion: Replace accented characters in free-text fields; ABS is an ASCII format and any other byte breaks the checksum

record_within_length_budget.fail: Line {line}: the record is {length} characters, over the standard's budget of {budget} per bending shape
record_within_length_budget.suggestion: Split the shape, or move project-internal data out of the private block

geometry_angle_terminated.fail: Line {line}: legs {legs} carry no bend angle
geometry_angle_terminated.suggestion: Follow every leg with its angle, and close a bar that ends straight with an explicit w0 so a machine can tell 'no bend' from 'angle not stated'

bend_radius_over_roller.fail: Line {line}: legs {legs} have a radius at or below half the bending-roller diameter ({limit} mm)
bend_radius_over_roller.suggestion: Raise the radius above half the roller diameter given in the header, or state a larger roller

developed_length_matches_header.fail: Line {line}: the geometry develops to {developed} mm but the header states {stated} mm, a difference of {gap} mm
developed_length_matches_header.suggestion: Correct the leg lengths or the header total; the machine follows the geometry, so the printed schedule and the cut bar would differ

mesh_coordinates_non_negative.fail: Line {line}: the mesh has negative bar coordinates ({coordinates})
mesh_coordinates_non_negative.suggestion: Move the mesh origin so the smallest x and the smallest y are zero
